intro: Las Vegas's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $112/month, down 4.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). StorageUnitCosts lists $113 (August 2026). Storage Stats puts the Las Vegas metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $123, down 16.4% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $114. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); Aug 2026 (StorageUnitCosts); Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $45 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $45 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$46.

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $70 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $70 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$70. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $112, down 4.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $113, down 2.6% from a year earlier (Aug 2026). Storage Stats Las Vegas metro non-climate asking rent $123, down 16.4% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Las Vegas alone. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$114.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $153 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$159.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $199 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $199 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$212.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Stewart Place (~$101), Downtown Las Vegas (~$108), The Strip (~$110) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Gateway District (~$364) is among the highest.
Las Vegas has about 215 facilities and 8.0 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 886,466 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 45.5% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
